Compare LayerNorm, RMSNorm, BatchNorm and Pre-LN/Post-LN, and explain why switching to Pre-LN cannot imply that any model can remove warmup.

evidence.text:
Different from these related work, the proposed RMSNorm modiﬁes the normalization structure by
removing the re-centering operation and regularizing the summed inputs with RMS alone. Our model
only maintains the re-scaling invariance property which we ﬁnd can be inherited when the RMS is
estimated from only subset of the summed inputs, partially inspired by the group normalization [34].
As a side effect, our model reduces the computational overhead and increases efﬁciency. Recently,
Zhang et al. [36] show that with careful initialization, residual networks can be trained as stable as
those with normalization. However, the approach mainly aims at improving residual networks and
can not be freely switched without modifying all initialization layers. Besides, it is not trivial to
be adapted to other general neural networks, such as RNNs where model depth expands along the
variable sequence length. By contrast, our model is simple, effective and can be used as a drop-in
replacement of LayerNorm.
3 Background
We brieﬂy review LayerNorm in this section based on a standard feed-forward neural network. Given
an input vector x∈ Rm, a feed-forward network projects it into an output vector y∈ Rn through a
linear transformation followed by a non-linear activation as follows:

are large. Therefore, without the warm-up stage, directly
using a large learning rate to those parameters can make
the optimization process unstable. Using a warm-up stage
and training the model with small learning rates practically
avoid this problem. Extensive experiments are provided to
support our theoretical ﬁndings.
Our theory also shows that the layer normalization plays a
crucial role in controlling the gradient scales. This motivates
us to investigate whether there are some other ways of po-
sitioning the layer normalization that lead to well-behaved
gradients. In particular, we study another variant, the Trans-
former with Pre-Layer Normalization (Pre-LN) (Baevski
& Auli, 2018; Child et al., 2019; Wang et al., 2019). The
Pre-LN Transformer puts the layer normalization inside the
residual connection and equips with an additionalﬁnal-layer
normalization before prediction (Please see Figure 1 for the
differences between the two variants of the Transformer
architectures). We show that at initialization, the gradients
are well-behaved without any exploding or vanishing for the
Pre-LN Transformer both theoretically and empirically.
Given the gradients are well-behaved in the Pre-LN Trans-
former, it is natural to consider removing the learning rate
warm-up stage during training. We conduct a variety of
experiments, including IWSLT14 German-English transla-
tion, WMT14 English-German translation, and BERT pre-
training tasks. We show that, in all tasks, the learning rate
warm-up stage can be safely removed, and thus, the number
of hyper-parameter is reduced. Furthermore, we observe
that the loss decays faster for the Pre-LN Transformer model.
It can achieve comparable ﬁnal performances but use much
less training time. This is particularly important for training
large-scale models on large-scale datasets.
Our contributions are summarized as follows:
• We investigate two Transformer variants, the Post-LN
Transformer and the Pre-LN Transformer, using mean ﬁeld
theory. By studying the gradients at initialization, we pro-
vide evidence to show why the learning rate warm-up stage
is essential in training the Post-LN Transformer.
• We are the ﬁrst to show that the learning-rate warm-up
stage can be removed for the Pre-LN Transformer, which
eases the hyperparameter tuning. We further show that by
using proper learning rate schedulers, the training time can
be largely reduced on a wide range of applications.
2. Related work
Gradient descent-based methods (Kingma & Ba, 2014;

Note that Twarmup (10k) is far less than the acceleration

to optimize using larger learning rates. We also evaluate
different model checkpoints on the downstream task MRPC
and RTE (more details can be found in the supplementary
material). The experiments results are plotted in Figure 5(b)
and 5(c). We can see that the Pre-LN model also converges

As a summary, all the experiments on different tasks show

learning rate warm-up stage and can be trained much faster
than the Post-LN Transformer.
5. Conclusion and Future Work
In this paper, we study why the learning rate warm-up stage
is important in training the Transformer and show that the
location of layer normalization matters. We show that in the
original Transformer, which locates the layer normalization
outside the residual blocks, the expected gradients of the
parameters near the output layer are large at initialization.
This leads to an unstable training when using a large learning
rate. We further show that the Transformer which locates the
layer normalization inside the residual blocks, can be trained
without the warm-up stage and converges much faster. In
the future, we will investigate other strategies of positioning
the layer normalization and understand the optimization of
Transformer from a theoretical perspective.

Overall, RMSNorm yields comparable translation quality compared with LayerNorm but incurs less

non-optimal implementation of tensor slicing operation in these computational frameworks, which

# LayerNorm：特征维归一化与BN/RMSNorm区别

> 状态：AI整理草稿，未获人工逐项确认。本文是完整知识词条，不是论文逐字原文。

## 定义与用途

LayerNorm对每个样本在指定特征维上计算当前输入均值与方差，统计不依赖同batch其他样本。

## 工作机制

常见Transformer输入(B,T,D)，LN(D)对每个(B,T)位置的D个特征计算μ与σ²，再施加逐特征γ、β。训练与推理通常都用当前输入统计，不像默认BN读取running mean/variance。RMSNorm使用均方根缩放但不减均值；Pre-LN/Post-LN描述的是子层摆放。

## 适用条件与易混淆点

归一化轴由normalized_shape决定，不能断言任何LN总只沿最后一维。LN不保证所有训练问题自动解决；位置、epsilon、精度与初始化均可能影响行为。

## 关联知识

BatchNorm：统计轴、训练与推理、归一化总览与RMSNorm、Pre-LN与Post-LN、残差连接：恒等路径、梯度与维度

# Pre-LN与Post-LN

> 状态：AI整理草稿，未获人工逐项确认。本文是完整知识词条，不是论文逐字原文。

## 定义与用途

Pre-LN与Post-LN区别在子层归一化相对残差的位置，而不是是否存在残差。

## 工作机制

常见Post-LN为y=LN(x+F(x))，Pre-LN为y=x+F(LN(x))，堆叠末端还可能有final norm。Pre-LN的残差支路保留直接恒等项；Post-LN的归一化作用于相加结果。相关论文分析初始化时的梯度规模并在其设置中考察warmup需求。

## 适用条件与易混淆点

不能由这些结构式推出任何训练都不会梯度消失/爆炸，也不能把论文实验结论说成普遍无需warmup。归一化类型LN/RMSNorm与摆放Pre/Post是不同选择。

## 关联知识

归一化总览与RMSNorm、训练：优化器、学习率与数值精度、Transformer 架构

# 归一化总览与RMSNorm

> 状态：AI整理草稿，未获人工逐项确认。本文是完整知识词条，不是论文逐字原文。

## 定义与用途

归一化调节特征尺度；统计轴、是否去均值及结构位置是三个独立选择。LayerNorm、RMSNorm和BatchNorm不能互换概念。

## 工作机制

LayerNorm对指定特征维计算当前样本均值与方差；RMSNorm使用均方根缩放，一般形式为x/√mean(x²+ε)*g，不进行均值中心化；BN按通道聚合批次及指定空间/序列位置。归一化位于子层前还是残差相加后，分别对应常见Pre-LN与Post-LN。

## 适用条件与易混淆点

RMSNorm省去中心化并不自动保证某硬件上更快。归一化参数量取决于是否有可学习bias和gain。mygpt中的峰值显存/时间属于具体实验，不能作为普遍收益。

## 关联知识

训练：优化器、学习率与数值精度、Decoder-only架构与mygpt实现、性能测量、正确性与适用条件、Pre-LN与Post-LN、BatchNorm：统计轴、训练与推理、LayerNorm：特征维归一化与BN/RMSNorm区别

# BatchNorm：统计轴、训练与推理

> 状态：AI整理草稿，未获人工逐项确认。本文是完整知识词条，不是论文逐字原文。

## 定义与用途

BatchNorm按特征/通道使用批次统计进行标准化，再用可学习γ和β缩放平移。它与对每个token特征维独立归一化的LN不同。

## 工作机制

y=γ*(x−μ)/√(σ²+ε)+β。PyTorch BatchNorm1d输入(N,C)或(N,C,L)，后者每通道统计跨N和L，而不是对每token的C维统计。默认训练使用当前批统计并更新running统计，eval使用running统计；track_running_stats=False时训练和eval都使用批统计。训练前向方差估计与running variance更新的估计口径还需区分。

## 适用条件与易混淆点

BN并非不能用于任何序列任务，但变长、padding和小批量会影响统计。原论文用internal covariate shift解释动机，不应把这当成唯一已证实的收益机制。

## 关联知识

LayerNorm：特征维归一化与BN/RMSNorm区别、归一化总览与RMSNorm、训练：优化器、学习率与数值精度
